project_context.core_goal: Fast morning-scan surface (3 seconds), scannable, dense, clinical, and premium
current_issues: Oversized zero-state alerts for Needs Attention
Low data density below the fold

typography.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule. We avoid standard 'Bold' everywhere. H1s will pair font-light with font-semibold. KPI numbers will be font-black (900) with tracking-tighter. Overlines will be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs.

colors.strategy: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4 adapted to clinical). We kill the rainbow gradients. We rely on the structural grayscale/navy for hierarchy. Color (Teal) is function only—used strictly to guide action and indicate active states. Surfaces will be flat and crisp.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Cards will have flat backgrounds, 1px subtle borders (border-navy/10), and NO heavy drop shadows by default.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Subtle roundness, max 8px (rounded-lg) for a sharp, precise medical software feel.
visual_enhancers.zero_state: Collapsed. Zero states shouldn't scream for attention. They should shrink to a minimal confirmation of health.

directions.name: Direction A: Command Deck (The Dense Grid)
directions.narrative: A hyper-dense, single-scan dashboard. Everything critical lives above the fold in a strict 12-column grid. The aesthetic is tactical and precise. The rainbow KPI cards are replaced by stark, white architectural cards with massive, high-contrast numbers.
directions.hierarchy: Data dominates. The greeting is secondary to the KPI numbers. Quick actions sit tightly clustered on the right rail.

solutions.duplicate_search: Completely removed from the page layout. The global top-nav (⌘K) handles all queries. The space reclaimed is used for the Date Pill and greeting.
solutions.kpi_tiles: No gradients. White background, 1px Navy border. The numbers are Plus Jakarta Sans, Black weight. A tiny Teal dot indicates a positive trend.
solutions.needs_attention_zero_state: Collapses into a single, slim, green-tinted text chip ('✓ All clear'). Only expands into cards when items > 0.
solutions.data_density: High. The fold accommodates KPIs, live timeline, and quick actions simultaneously.

directions.name: Direction B: Focus Feed (Task-First)
directions.narrative: Treats the day like a chronological feed. Instead of focusing on static numbers, it prioritizes the live pulse of the clinic. The center column is a running feed of what is happening right now, while KPIs are reduced to an executive sidebar.
directions.hierarchy: The 'In Test Now' timeline dominates the visual center. Metrics are tertiary, living quietly on the left.

solutions.duplicate_search: Removed. Replaced by a clean typographic header.
solutions.kpi_tiles: Stripped of cards entirely. KPIs are treated as a minimalist list (label: value) on the left rail, saving massive horizontal space.
solutions.needs_attention_zero_state: Moved to the right rail as a discreet 'toolbar' list. Zero values are muted gray, non-intrusive.

directions.name: Direction C: Editorial Overview (Asymmetric Artful)
directions.narrative: A bold, magazine-style layout that uses asymmetry to create visual interest. The left rail acts as a sticky command center with your greeting and actions, while the right side is a 'Bento Box' grid of live data and charts.
directions.hierarchy: The Typography of the greeting and Date dominates the left. The Bento grid of data dominates the right.

solutions.duplicate_search: Removed. The left rail anchors the entire dashboard without needing filler.
solutions.kpi_tiles: Bento style. Some tiles span 2 columns, some 1. We use the Navy (#0F1D3A) background with White text for the most critical metric (e.g., Appointments) to create a focal point, leaving the rest White.
solutions.needs_attention_zero_state: Sits inline as regular body text in the left rail. 'Needs Attention: 0. All systems optimal.'

motion.hover_states: Cards subtly lift (-translate-y-1) and gain a shadow-md. Borders shift from border-navy/10 to border-teal/40.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-in (framer-motion) for the KPI tiles to make the data feel 'live' upon mounting.
motion.zero_state_transition: If a zero-state alert suddenly becomes > 0 (via websocket/polling), it smoothly expands its height rather than snapping instantly.

accessibility.contrast: All text strictly meets 4.5:1 WCAG AA minimums against #EEF1FA and #FFFFFF. Teal is used carefully to ensure contrast on white.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT implement code yet. The user will review the `design_guidelines.json` mockups and select Direction A, B, or C.
When a direction is chosen, completely remove the secondary page-level search input.
Remove all rainbow gradients and replace with flat, 1px border cards.
Utilize Plus Jakarta Sans for the KPI numbers to give them a premium geometric feel.
Handle the 'Needs Attention' strip dynamically: if array length is 0, render the collapsed elegant state defined by the chosen direction.
Ensure the layout is built strictly with CSS Grid (`grid-cols-12` or asymmetric setups) rather than nested flexboxes where possible, for rigidity.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Use glass-morphism effects carefully.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use standard lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
